scope:
Native foreground presentation pilot on unchanged production HTML.

Diagnostic navigation selects authored Aubagne (not a surveyed Marseille view),
places the camera at an existing collision-free road point, grants twelve ordinary
weapons for a presentation matrix and ammunition for their real reload checks. Active
simulation is stepped with the inherited diagnostic v020Tick; UI inputs, Canvas,
WebGL scene, collisions, firing, reload and browser storage remain production.
No network, renderer, input handler or localStorage is replaced.

input_hardware_claim: Native Chromium mouse and keyboard; portrait pointer events are simulated by Playwright, not physical touch hardware.
assistance: Existing authored Aubagne selected through v020Load.
Camera diagnostic at [0,1.65,85], actual production collision/LOS checked.
v020GrantWeapon equips twelve ordinary weapons for presentation inspection; not acquisition or balancing evidence.
v020Seed supplies finite ordinary ammunition reserves for the presentation reload matrix.
v020Tick(.05,true) steps active production simulation while frame progression is frozen for reproducible screenshots.
v028Settings controls existing reduceMotion/reducedFlashes settings for their visible checks.
